content: Uyurem di Tfawt
A iḥenjiren inu, uriɣ aya i kenniw, ḥima war txeṭṭim ca. Uca mařa ixḍa ca n ijjen, aqa ɣarneɣ Umseṣřaḥ, d Wenni iǧan ɣar Babatneɣ, Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ, Amseggad.
Maɣar Netta d aṣřaḥ i ddnub nneɣ, war iǧi x ddnub nneɣ waha, maca ɛawed i yinni n ddunect marra.
S man aya i nettwařa belli aqa nessen i-t, mařa neṭṭef di tweṣṣa nnes.
Wenni iqqaren: “Necc ssneɣ t!”, maca war iṭṭif ca di tweṣṣa nnes, netta d bu-ixarriqen uca tidett war dayes teǧi.
Maca wenni ittᵉṭṭfen deg wawař nnes, ad dayes tkemmeř tayri n AREBBI s tidett. S man aya nessen, belli aqa neccin dayes.
Wenni iqqaren: ‘Necc dayes!’, ittxeṣṣa ad yuyur am mammec tuɣa iggur Netta.
A imɛizzen inu, war d awem ttariɣ ca tawṣeyyet n jdid, maca tawṣeyyet taqdimt i tuɣa ɣarwem zeg umezwaru. Tawṣeyyet-a taqdimt d awař i tuɣa tesřim.
Waxxa amenni ad awem dd-ariɣ tawṣeyyet n jdid, tenni iǧan d tidett dayes u daywem, minzi taǧest teɛdu uca Tafawt n tidett aqa tᵉtteḍhar-dd řexxu.
Wenni iqqaren belli aqa-t di Tfawt, maca icarreh umas, netta aqa-t di taǧest ař iḍa.
Wenni ittexsen umas, ad iqqim di Tfawt uca war dayes bu řefḍiḥet i zi ɣa inqard umas.
Maca wenni icarrhen umas, aqa-t di taǧest uca iggur di taǧest, war issin mani ɣa iraḥ, minzi taǧest tessdarɣeř tiṭṭawin nnes.
Tayri n Arebbi, Babatneɣ
Ad awem dd-ariɣ, a iḥenjiren, minzi ddnub nwem ttwaɣfaren awem di ṭṭweɛ n Yisem nnes.
Ad awem dd-ariɣ, a ibabaten, minzi aqa tessnem Wenni iǧan zeg umezwaru. Ad awem dd-ariɣ, a ibřiɣen, minzi aqa tɣellbem x umɛeffan.
Aqa uriɣ awem-dd, a iḥudriyyen, minzi tessnem Babatneɣ.
Aqa uriɣ awem-dd, a ibabaten, minzi tessnem Wenni iǧan zeg umezwaru. Aqa uriɣ awem-dd, a ibřiɣen, minzi aqa kenniw tjehdem uca Awař n AREBBI izeddeɣ daywem uca tɣellbem x umɛeffan.
War ttexsem ca ddunect uřa d min iǧan di ddunect, minzi mařa ca n ijjen ittexs ddunect, tayri n Babatneɣ war dayes teǧi.
Minzi marra min iǧan di ddunect - aqa-t d nnecwet n ddat d nnecwet n tiṭṭawin d tuffet n ddunect-a - war dd-ittis ca zi Babatneɣ, maca zi ddunect.
Uca ddunect tɛeddu uřa d nnecwat nnes, maca wenni itteggen min ixs AREBBI, ad iqqim i řebda.
Lmasiḥ issxarriqen
A iḥenjiren inu, aqa řweqt taneggarut tiweḍ-dd, uca am tesřim belli ad dd-yas lmasiḥ afalsu, amenni řexxu ḍharen-dd aṭṭas n imasiḥen ifalsuten. S uyenni nessen belli řweqt taneggarut aqa tiweḍ-dd.
Ffɣen-dd zzayneɣ, maca war ten tuɣi zzayneɣ. Meɛlik nitni tuɣa zzayneɣ, ad iři qqimen akidneɣ. Maca nitni ffɣen-dd zzayneɣ, ḥima ad iban belli nitni marra war ǧin ca zzayneɣ.
Aqa ɣarwem adhan n Umqeddas uca tessnem ad tfarzem kuř ijj n bnadem.
War d awem uriɣ minzi war tessinem ca tidett, maca minzi aqa tᵉttessnem tt, u tessnem ɛawed uřa d ijj n uxarriq war dd-itteffeɣ ca zi tidett.
Wi iǧan d bu-ixarriqen mɣir wenni inkaren belli Yasuɛ d Lmasiḥ! D wa d lmasiḥ afalsu, wenni inkaren Babas d Mmis.
Marra wenni inkaren Mmis war yumin ɛawed di Babas. Wenni icehhden i Mmis, icehhed ɛawed i Babas.
Ejj ad daywem iqqim min tesřim zeg umezwaru. Mařa iqqim daywem min tesřim zeg umezwaru, ad teqqimem kenniw ɛawed di Babas u di Mmis.
Ta d tikkest n wawař i d aneɣ iwca: Tudart ittduman.
Man aya uriɣ awem-t-i-dd x yinni kenniw ixeddɛen.

Mařa adhan i zzayes tᵉṭṭfem ad iqqim daywem, war teḥdajem ad kenniw isseřmed ḥed. Minzi adhan n AREBBI, ad kenniw isseřmad di marra, uca Netta d tidett war dayes ǧin ixarriqen. Xenni qqimem dayes, di Lmasiḥ, am mammec i d awem isseřmed Netta.
Xenni řexxu, a iḥenjiren inu, qqimem dayes, ḥima war nettseḍḥi ca qibač nnes x minni dd ɣa iḍhar, maca ad ɣarneɣ tiři ttiqqet ɣar twasit nnes.
Mařa tessnem, belli Netta d amseggad, snem ɛawed belli marra wi itteggen tasegda, aqa ittwaxřeq-dd zzayes.

Netta d anabi!’ Man aya ixs ad yini belli nitni war ssteɛtarifen u war neɛɛmen ca, aqa AREBBI yusa-dd di arrimet n Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ am mammec i d aneɣ isseřmed Wedlis Iqeddsen. S uyenni tteggen nitni am mammec ittegg lmasiḥ afalsu, war cehhden ca aqa Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ yusa-dd di arrimet. S uyenni ḍeffaren t deg ixarriqen nnes, nitni d iḥenjiren n ddejjař.
